facts.text: BunchOfColors3-v0 is registered by @register_env with max_episode_steps=120
The abstract BunchOfColorsEnv defaults SEQUENCE_LENGTH to 5
The environment supports the panda and panda_wristcam robots and defines nine colors
An episode draws SEQUENCE_LENGTH unique colors from the nine with the episode RNG
The robot qpos is a nine-element vector and its last two entries are handled as the gripper
In state mode the observation extras are tcp_pose, obj_to_goal_pos, oracle_info and, for each cube in the scene, its pose and its touch/sequence/next-target flags
The environment's step delegates to BaseEnv.step and returns its five values unchanged
The dense reward combines reaching, 0.5*static, correct-touch and wrong-touch terms, is scaled by active_phase and set to 100 on success
compute_normalized_dense_reward divides the dense reward by 100
The default sensors are a 128x128 base_camera and a 512x512 render_camera
The environment's SimConfig sets only GPU memory capacities, not a physics or control timestep
ManiSkill's BaseEnv is imported from mani_skill.envs.sapien_env, so reset, the spaces and close are inherited outside the clone
The clone documents the Panda pd_ee_delta_pose action as seven values, each in [-1, 1]: xyz, rpy and the gripper command
The documented proprioception is seven values: absolute TCP xyz with no finite clamp, roll/pitch/yaw and the gripper opening in [0.0, 0.08] m
The clone pins gymnasium 0.29.1, mani_skill 3.0.0b15, numpy 1.23.5 and torch 2.2.1 and requires Python >=3.9,<3.12

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds the fake's Python random stream for the initial pose jitter and the kinematic integration is deterministic, so one seed repeats a trajectory of this fake; upstream draws from ManiSkill's episode RNG, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator, sensor or noise model: the fake integrates the seven documented action values by a fixed toy kinematic mapping and makes no physics claim

the Panda robot, the nine cubes, the table scene, the camera sensors and the ManiSkill task and reward logic are not modelled; the fake returns reward 0.0 and never terminates an episode, it only truncates at the registered 120-step limit

the real observation is ManiSkill's state tensor plus the extra keys of bunch_of_colors.py:324-336; its exact size depends on the robot and sensors and is not stated in the clone.  The fake returns a seven-value proprio-like stand-in (absolute xyz, rpy and gripper opening), not that array

timestep_ms is 0: the clone states no physics or control timestep (SimConfig at bunch_of_colors.py:53-59 sets only GPU memory capacities), so the fake advances one step per tick and makes no wall-clock claim

the fake's initial pose and joint jitter are marked placeholder test data and were never compared with the upstream environment; the upstream stack (mani_skill 3.0.0b15, torch 2.2.1) is not importable where the gate runs (pyproject.toml:10, :26-32)

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are refused after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the recorded world state stays readable
